_comment: CF-001. Live-verified 2026-10-30 against the Cloudflare API (global key, account abb783e456e51a5d338419de93d5e576). The account holds 18 Workers and 5 Pages projects; this repo's workflows deploy only 7 of the Workers and 2 of the Pages projects. This file is the committed baseline the drift check compares against. Every entry must be either tracked (a workflow in .github/workflows deploys it) or waived (a deliberate, reviewed exception with a reason). Adding a live resource means adding it here; the drift check fails until you do.
